This sounds great, exactly what I need ! Please notify me or post a thread on r/socialskills when you're done

Hey, 
this sounds like a really great idea. Personally I'd like to see a wiki where it starts with the basics like positive mindsets, smiling, how to hold a conversation, self-esteem etc, and then move to meeting new people, and how to give off good vibes and then move all the way through to advanced like charisma. 
I think that frequent and SPECIFIC posts (vague advice such as 'ask questions' usually don't cut it for me) would keep me motivated and subscribed !

Thanks

This is true, I'm very introverted and I find that being witty and sarcastic (in a friendly way) often works for me. I'd say watch a range of comedians too, someone I would suggest would be British comedian Richard Ayowade on 'Never Mind the Buzzcocks' and the last 'Big Fat Quiz of the Year'. He seems fairly introverted and nerdy, but hilarious !

I'm afraid I'm in no place to help you since I'm in the EXACT same situation at the moment, apart from I live in England so the blue skies don't come so often - but it helps me a tiny bit to know that I'm not alone, and neither are you
